title: Codelessly layout document (schema 2)
description: Generated from the codelessly_api declarations. It rejects unknown node types, unknown keys, wrong value types and enum values, and numbers out of bounds. It cannot check: references between nodes (children, slots and roots that name no node, a node with two parents, cycles, unreachable nodes); layout fields that only some parents read (x/y outside a stack, flex/align outside a row or column) and sizing modes a parent cannot honor; binding paths (keys of "bind") and the names expressions read; action targets (node ids, screens, variables) and the patches interaction states apply; variable values against their type, conditions' node and path references, breakpoint ids; formulas (the language is the SDK's). Run validateDocument (package:codelessly_api/validate.dart) or tool/render/render.sh for those. It is stricter than the decoders where they read loosely: a number written as text, a color without "#".
